author: Krono III
title: Arch Ablation 3: No Dilated Convolutions
abstract: This is the third and final experiment in my architectural ablation study. I will quantify the contribution of dilated convolutions by removing them from the CNN encoder. I hypothesize that the expanded receptive field from dilation is important for performance, and its removal will result in a lower score.
